lyrics:
[Intro: slow synth arpeggio, deep kick, long pad]

[Build: bass enters, hi-hats, arpeggio opens]

[Verse 1: yearning male tenor, reverbed]
I'm out past the rope
Where the lights don't go
Water's warm, the night is wide
I won't call, I won't decide

[Chorus: chords lift, voice doubled]
If you want to, swim out to me
I'll be treading water, I'll be easy to see
No hurry, no hurry
If you want to, swim out to me

[Instrumental: arpeggio rising, strings join]

[Verse 2: voice closer, bass moving]
I can hear you on the stair
Feet in, breathing, standing there
I've been where you are before
Scared of what the deep is for

[Chorus: chords lift, voice doubled]
If you want to, swim out to me
I'll be treading water, I'll be easy to see
No hurry, no hurry
If you want to, swim out to me

[Break: kick drops out, pads and voice]
No hurry
No hurry

[Final Build and Release: everything returns, voices layered]
If you want to, swim out to me
I'll be treading water, I'll be easy to see
No hurry, no hurry
If you want to, swim out to me

[Outro: arpeggio alone, slowing, water moving]
